description: Coolant distribution unit of the DH08 liquid-cooled pod: facility-water heat exchanger and secondary pumps. Its air connection to DH08 carries no air; it removes the liquid-cooled share of the hall's IT load directly (review A17). The Ignition UDT inherits Dashboard for its energy KPIs.

pump_failure.description: One secondary pump fails; the unit continues on the rest.

capacity_fraction.description: Available capacity as a fraction of rated.

trip.description: Unit trips and its secondary pumps stop until reset.

name: Coolant distribution unit

m_facility_flow_nominal.description: Facility CHW flow at design (14 / 20 degC).

pump_count.description: Secondary pumps in the unit (members Pump 1-3).

q_nominal.description: Design heat removal: DH08 1,200 kW x 40 % liquid over three CDUs (site data: plant-design.json basis.it).

v_trip_pu.description: Undervoltage trip: the drive stops below this supply voltage.

air_out.description: Heat removed from the served hall's IT load (no air flows).
